data.name: HeicRefused
data.value: HEIC/HEIF is not accepted. The reason is the HEVC patent situation rather than a technical one - save the picture as JPEG or PNG and it comes straight in. AVIF is unaffected and is supported.

data.name: NotAnImageFormat
data.value: This kind of file is not accepted - it is not an image format but a script or a fetching coder.

data.name: DecodingStopped
data.value: Decoding was stopped: the image needs more memory than is allowed. Its header may have understated its size.

data.name: FormatUnreadable
data.value: This build cannot read that format.

data.name: NotReadableAsImage
data.value: The file could not be read as an image: {0}

data.name: TokenNoContent
data.value: This file is not a MapTool token: it has no content.xml.

data.name: TokenSomethingElse
data.value: This file is not a MapTool token: its content.xml describes something else.

data.name: TokenNoPicture
data.value: This token holds no picture that could be read - neither a portrait nor a map token.

data.name: ArchiveUnreadable
data.value: This file is not a readable archive.

data.name: ArchiveTooManyEntries
data.value: This archive holds {0} entries, which is beyond anything a token has (limit {1}).

data.name: TokenDescriptionUnreadable
data.value: The description inside this token could not be read. It is either damaged or it declares a document type, which is not accepted.
